name: map-polygon-creation
description: Draw map polygons with one click: select roads, buildings and areas from OpenStreetMap or AI on aerial imagery, cut or extend them, and export them as GeoJSON zones (ignore motion / priority alerts).
author: noamAnaf100

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
